entries.title: Proverbs 20:1
segments: ¶Wine is a scorner, strong drink is raging; and whoso erreth thereby is not wise.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:2
segments: ¶The terror of a king is as the roaring of a lion: he that provoketh him to anger sinneth against his own soul.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:3
segments: ¶It is an honour for a man to cease from strife; but every fool rusheth into it.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:4
segments: ¶The sluggard will not plough by reason of the winter; he shall beg in harvest, and have nothing.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:5
segments: ¶Counsel in the heart of man is deep water, and a man of understanding draweth it out.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:6
segments: ¶Most men will proclaim every one his own kindness; but a faithful man who shall find?

entries.title: Proverbs 20:7
segments: ¶The righteous walketh in his integrity: blessed are his children after him!

entries.title: Proverbs 20:8
segments: ¶A king sitting on the throne of judgment scattereth away all evil with his eyes.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:9
segments: ¶Who can say, I have made my heart clean, I am pure from my sin?

entries.title: Proverbs 20:10
segments: ¶Divers weights, divers measures, even both of them are abomination to Jehovah.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:11
segments: ¶Even a child is known by his doings, whether his work be pure, and whether it be right.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:12
segments: ¶The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, Jehovah hath made even both of them.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:13
segments: ¶Love not sleep, lest thou come to poverty; open thine eyes, [and] thou shalt be satisfied with bread.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:14
segments: ¶Bad! bad! saith the buyer; but when he is gone his way, then he boasteth.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:15
segments: ¶There is gold, and a multitude of rubies; but the lips of knowledge are a precious Jewel.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:16
segments: ¶Take his garment that is become surety [for] another, and hold him in pledge for strangers.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:17
segments: ¶Bread of falsehood is sweet to a man, but afterwards his mouth shall be filled with gravel.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:18
segments: ¶Plans are established by counsel; and with good advice make war.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:19
segments: ¶He that goeth about talebearing revealeth secrets; therefore meddle not with him that openeth his lips.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:20
segments: ¶Whoso curseth his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in the blackest darkness.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:21
segments: ¶An inheritance obtained hastily at the beginning will not be blessed in the end.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:22
segments: ¶Say not, I will recompense evil: wait on Jehovah, and he shall save thee.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:23
segments: ¶Divers weights are an abomination unto Jehovah; and a false balance is not good.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:24
segments: ¶The steps of a man are from Jehovah; and how can a man understand his own way?

entries.title: Proverbs 20:25
segments: ¶It is a snare to a man rashly to say, It is hallowed, and after vows to make inquiry.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:26
segments: ¶A wise king scattereth the wicked, and bringeth the wheel over them.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:27
segments: ¶Man's spirit is the lamp of Jehovah, searching all the inner parts of the belly.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:28
segments: ¶Mercy and truth preserve the king; and he upholdeth his throne by mercy.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:29
segments: ¶The glory of young men is their strength; and the beauty of old men is the grey head.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:30
segments: ¶Wounding stripes purge away evil, and strokes [purge] the inner parts of the belly.
